methods.label: Bound the distance using PB
methods.explanation: The perpendicular segment is the shortest. The distance from point \(P\) to \(l\) does not exceed the length of any connecting segment, so it is no greater than \(PB=3\) cm (but is not necessarily equal to \(3\) cm).
methods.levelReason: Uses the Grade 7 definition of point-to-line distance and the shortest-perpendicular-segment fact.
